counter.opened: Sign turned to OPEN. {visitors} visitors expected.
counter.arrived: Visitor {n} steps up to the counter.

satisfied: “Does what it says on the sign.”
neutral: Folds it once. Heads back to the road.
Takes the slice without a word.
disgusted: Looks at the counter, then at the slice.
Wipes both hands on a sleeve.
passed: Checks the sign and keeps walking.
